
Phase Prompts — Lovable Build Guide

> Copy and customize the relevant prompt for each phase.
> Always PIN after completing each phase.

---

Phase 0 — UI Foundation
Goal: Build all pages as static UI. No auth, no database, no API calls.
Prompt Template:

```
Create the following pages with static/mock data:

1. Landing Page:
   - Hero: headline + subheadline + CTA button
   - Features section (3-4 cards with icons)
   - How it works (3 steps)
   - Pricing (2-3 plans)
   - Footer
   - Smooth scroll-triggered reveal animations (Framer Motion)

2. Dashboard (placeholder):
   - Sidebar navigation
   - Main content area with placeholder cards
   - Top bar with user avatar placeholder

3. [Additional pages as needed]

Use shadcn/ui components. Tailwind styling. Mobile-responsive.
Do NOT add authentication or database. Mock data only.
Do NOT install unnecessary packages.
```

## After completion: PIN this version.

Phase 1 — Auth & Database
Goal: Connect Supabase. Implement auth flow. Create database tables.
Prompt Template:

```
Connect Supabase to this project.

1. Authentication:
   - Sign up with email/password
   - Login page
   - Logout functionality
   - Protected routes: redirect to /login if no session
   - Store user profile in a `profiles` table

2. Database tables:
   [List your tables with columns — reference PRD]

3. RLS Policies:
   - Enable RLS on ALL tables
   - Users can only read/write their own data
   - Admin role can access all data

Do not modify the landing page or existing UI.
Do not touch: [list files to protect]
```

## After completion: PIN. Test: signup → login → protected route → logout.

Phase 2 — Core Features
Goal: Implement main business logic, one feature per prompt.
Prompt Template (per feature):

```
Implement [FEATURE NAME] on the [PAGE] page.

Requirements:
- [Specific behavior 1]
- [Specific behavior 2]
- [Edge case handling]

Data source: Supabase table `[table_name]`
User role: [which role sees this]

Include:
- Loading skeleton while data fetches
- Error state with retry button
- Empty state with CTA to create first item

Do not modify: [files to protect]
```

## After each feature: PIN.

Phase 3 — API & Edge Functions
Goal: Third-party integrations via Supabase Edge Functions.
Prompt Template:

```
Create a Supabase Edge Function for [PURPOSE].

Requirements:
- Endpoint: /functions/v1/[function-name]
- Input: [describe expected input]
- Output: [describe expected response]
- Store API key in Supabase Secrets (NOT in client code)
- Input validation with Zod
- Error handling: return structured { error: { code, message } }
- [Rate limiting if applicable]

Call this Edge Function from [COMPONENT] when [TRIGGER].
```

---

Phase 4 — Polish & Motion
Goal: Animations, responsive fine-tuning, state completeness.
Prompt Template:

```
Polish the [PAGE/COMPONENT]:

1. Add Framer Motion animations:
   - Page entry: fade in + slide up (300ms)
   - List items: stagger reveal (50ms between items)
   - Buttons: hover scale(1.02), click scale(0.98)

2. Responsive check:
   - Mobile (375px): single column, touch-friendly targets
   - Tablet (768px): adjusted grid
   - Desktop (1280px): full layout

3. Verify all 4 states exist:
   - Loading: skeleton shimmer
   - Error: message + retry action
   - Empty: illustration + CTA
   - Success: actual content

4. Add prefers-reduced-motion support.

Do not change business logic or data fetching.
```

---

Phase 5 — Security Audit
Goal: Verify security before deployment. Use Plan Mode.
Prompt (Plan Mode):

```
Perform a comprehensive security audit. Do NOT modify any code.

Check and report:
1. RLS: List every Supabase table. Flag any WITHOUT RLS policies.
2. Secrets: Search all .tsx/.ts for hardcoded API keys, passwords, tokens.
3. Validation: Check all user inputs for Zod validation. Flag unvalidated.
4. Auth: Review protected routes, token handling, session management.
5. Permissions: Verify role-based access (user vs admin).
6. Stripe: Webhook signature verification? Client-side price trust?
7. File uploads: Type/size validation? Storage bucket permissions?

Deliver a report with: ✅ passed, ⚠️ warning, ❌ critical.
```

---

Phase 6 — Deploy
Goal: Production deployment with custom domain.
Pre-deploy checklist:

````
Before deploying to production, verify:

- [ ] All security audit items resolved
- [ ] Loading/error/empty states on every page
- [ ] Mobile responsive tested (375px, 768px, 1280px)
- [ ] Auth flow: signup → login → protected → logout
- [ ] Console.log removed from production code
- [ ] SEO: page titles, meta descriptions, OG tags
- [ ] Favicon and brand assets in place
- [ ] 404 page exists and is styled
- [ ] Error boundary wraps the app

Deploy: Publish → Custom domain → Verify SSL.
```Debugging Playbook — Lovable Escalation Protocol
> When something breaks, follow this escalation. Each level costs more credits — start simple.
---
Level 1 — Simple Fix (First Try)
When: Clear error message, isolated issue.
Prompt:
````

Fix the [SPECIFIC ERROR] on [PAGE/COMPONENT].

Console shows: [paste exact error message]

Expected: [what should happen]
Actual: [what is happening]

Do not modify anything outside [FILE].

```
If "Try to Fix" appears: Click it (free, no credit). Max 3 times.
---
Level 2 — Analysis Mode (After 3 Failed Fixes)
When: Try to Fix failed 3x. Error keeps coming back or shifting.
Prompt:
```

The issue persists after multiple fix attempts.

STOP all code modifications.

Analyze the following:

1. What is the exact error and where does it originate?
2. What is the expected flow vs actual flow?
3. Which files and dependencies are involved?
4. What are the possible root causes?

Report your findings BEFORE suggesting any fix.

```
---
Level 3 — System Audit (Persistent Issues)
When: Analysis didn't lead to resolution. Issue might be architectural.
Prompt (Plan Mode):
```

This problem requires a system-wide audit.

Halt ALL code edits. Map the entire flow:

- Authentication state
- Database queries and RLS policies
- Component state management
- API calls and responses
- Route guards and redirects

Document:

- Expected behavior at each step
- Current (broken) behavior at each step
- Where the discrepancy occurs

Generate a comprehensive report. Do NOT modify any code.

```
---
Level 4 — Clean Rebuild (Nuclear Option)
When: Issue is too entangled to fix. Usually faster to rebuild the component.
Prompt:
```

The [COMPONENT/FEATURE] is fundamentally broken and needs a clean rewrite.

Here is the specification for what it should do:

- [Behavior 1]
- [Behavior 2]
- [Data sources]
- [User interactions]
- [Edge cases]

Delete the current implementation and rebuild from scratch.
Follow the Knowledge Base rules.

```
---
Emergency Patterns
"Everything Broke After Last Change"
```

Revert to the last pinned version.
Compare the current version with the pinned version.
What changed? What files were modified?

```
"Auth Randomly Stops Working"
```

Check the Supabase auth flow in Plan Mode:

1. Is the session being checked on protected routes?
2. Is the auth state listener properly set up?
3. Are there any race conditions on initial load?
4. Is token refresh working correctly?
   Report before making changes.

```
"Data Not Showing"
```

Debug the data flow for [TABLE]:

1. Is the Supabase query correct?
2. Are RLS policies allowing the current user to read?
3. Is the component waiting for data before rendering?
4. Check console for Supabase errors.
   Report before making changes.

````
"Styling Broke on Mobile"
Use Visual Edit (free) instead of prompts for CSS fixes.
---
Credit-Saving Rules
Visual Edit first: Color, text, spacing changes → Visual Edit (free).
Plan Mode for diagnosis: Don't spend credits on guessing. Diagnose first.
Try to Fix = free: Use it up to 3 times before escalating.
One fix per prompt: Don't combine bug fixes. Isolate and fix one at a time.
Screenshot always: Attach screenshots of the bug. AI diagnoses faster.
PIN religiously: Every working state gets a PIN. You can always go back.
  Design System — Lovable Edition
> Reference for UI/UX prompts. Key sections can be pasted into Knowledge Base.
---
Visual Principles
Not a generic dashboard. Portfolio-grade quality. Suitable for Awwwards, design galleries.
Typography
Font: Inter (system default) or Satoshi
Scale: 12 / 14 / 16 / 20 / 24 / 32 / 48 / 64px
Headings: tight tracking (-0.02em to -0.04em), line-height 1.1-1.2
Body: default tracking, line-height 1.5-1.6
Hierarchy drives layout — not color, not borders
Color (CSS Custom Properties)
```css
:root {
  --background: 0 0% 100%;
  --foreground: 222 84% 5%;
  --primary: [YOUR HUE] [SAT]% [LIGHT]%;
  --primary-foreground: 0 0% 100%;
  --muted: 210 40% 96%;
  --muted-foreground: 215 16% 47%;
  --accent: 210 40% 96%;
  --border: 214 32% 91%;
  --destructive: 0 84% 60%;
}
````

Restrained palette. One accent + neutral scale.
Impact from motion and depth, not color variety.
Dark mode: design dark-first for dev/creator audiences.
Spacing
8px grid (Tailwind: p-2 = 8px, p-4 = 16px, p-8 = 32px)
Generous whitespace. When in doubt → add more space.
Max content: 1200px (dashboard), 720px (reading content)
Gutters: 16px mobile, 24px tablet, 32px desktop
Buttons
Primary CTA: filled, accent color. ONE per viewport.
Secondary: outline/border variant. Tertiary: ghost/text.
No oversized buttons. No glossy effects.
Max border-radius: rounded-lg (8px). No pill shapes unless toggle.
States: hover scale(1.02), active scale(0.98), focus ring, disabled opacity.
Shadows (3 Levels)
Level 0: flat (tables, inputs)
Level 1: shadow-sm — cards, list items
Level 2: shadow-md — dropdowns, popovers
Level 3: shadow-lg — modals, drawers

---

Motion Design (Framer Motion)
Motion is a core design element, not decoration.
Required Patterns
Page transitions: AnimatePresence + motion.div crossfade/slide (300-400ms)
Scroll reveals: whileInView + initial={{ opacity: 0, y: 20 }}. Stagger: 50-80ms.
Micro-interactions: Button press, toggle, form feedback, card hover lift.
State transitions: loading→content, empty→populated: smooth opacity+translateY.
Hover depth: Cards: translateY(-2px) + shadow increase.
Timing
UI elements: 200-400ms
Dramatic reveals: 600-1000ms
Easing: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] for entrances. ease-out for exits.
Stagger: sequential, never simultaneous.
Accessibility
Respect `prefers-reduced-motion` via Tailwind `motion-safe:` prefix.
Provide instant alternatives for all animations.
Never block content behind animation completion.
Example: Stagger Reveal

```tsx
const container = { hidden: { opacity: 0 }, visible: { opacity: 1, transition: { staggerChildren: 0.06 } } };
const item = { hidden: { opacity: 0, y: 20 }, visible: { opacity: 1, y: 0, transition: { duration: 0.5, ease: [0.16, 1, 0.3, 1] } } };
```

---

Landing Page Structure

```
Hero
  → Strong headline + subheadline + single CTA
  → Animated entry: staggered text reveal + element fade
  → Background: gradient mesh, subtle pattern, or illustration

Social Proof
  → Logo strip or testimonial. Subtle infinite scroll.

Features (3-5 sections)
  → Scroll-triggered reveal
  → Alternate: text-left/visual-right, then flip
  → Visuals: animated product mockups, not static screenshots

How It Works
  → 3-4 steps with connecting line/timeline animation

Pricing
  → Card layout. Highlight recommended plan.
  → Toggle: monthly/yearly with animated switch.

Final CTA
  → Full-width, high contrast. Repeat primary CTA.

Footer
  → Minimal. Links + legal. No clutter.
```

---

Component States (Mandatory)
Every data-driven component must have all four:

```tsx
// Loading — skeleton shimmer, never blank
if (isLoading) return <Skeleton className="h-48 w-full rounded-lg" />;

// Error — actionable message + retry
if (error) return <Alert variant="destructive"><p>{error.message}</p><Button onClick={refetch}>Retry</Button></Alert>;

// Empty — illustration + CTA
if (data.length === 0) return <EmptyState title="No items yet" action={<Button>Create first</Button>} />;

// Success — actual content
return <DataList items={data} />;
```

---

Responsive Breakpoints
Breakpoint Width Layout
Mobile 375px Single column, stacked cards, hamburger nav
Tablet 768px 2-column grid, collapsible sidebar
Desktop 1280px Full layout, expanded sidebar, multi-column
Mobile-first: design for 375px, then enhance upward.

---

Performance Budget
Despite advanced visuals:
60fps animations. No jank.
Largest Contentful Paint < 2.5s
Cumulative Layout Shift < 0.1
Lazy load below-fold animations and heavy components
Code-split: Framer Motion ~40KB, load only when needed
Images: WebP format, lazy loading, explicit width/height
